description: Frame+Mattress+Cover bundle definitions for Bundle Builder S1. Each record defines one valid bundle configuration with pricing. addBundle() reads this collection to build cart line items.

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: Bundle display name, e.g. 'Sunset Complete Set'

fields.name: frameProductId
fields.description: Wix product ID of the frame component

fields.name: mattressProductId
fields.description: Wix product ID of the mattress component

fields.name: coverProductId
fields.description: Wix product ID of the cover component

fields.name: bundlePrice
fields.description: Discounted total price for the bundle

fields.name: savings
fields.description: Dollar savings vs. buying all 3 items individually

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: When false, bundle is excluded from getBundlesByFrame and addBundle

notes: bundleTag is NOT stored here — it is derived at runtime as 'bundle:<_id>'
bundlePrice is authoritative — clients cannot override pricing
A single frame may have multiple bundles (different cover options)
